http/conversation#

Conversations: one connection speaking HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2, as a client pool holds them.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Conversations: one connection speaking HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2, as a client pool holds them.

HttpTransport keeps conversations per origin and sends each request on one that is accepting. An HTTP/1.1 conversation takes one request at a time; an HTTP/2 one multiplexes. Programs use HttpClient instead.
